{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gorshian hands of death''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was native to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gorsh]]. Its three-meter-wide leaves supported a carnivorous flower that was known to consume [[Human/Legends|Human]] heads on more than one occasion.
